entries.title: Endro and Society
entries.summary: Conceptual.
entries.intro: Conceptual. Nothing here is confirmed canon.
entries.html:
Economy

  • Endro can be gathered by "emotion machines" owned by great clans and corporations. Potentially very dystopian.
  • Entire industries: producers, middlemen, customers. A full economy around Endro.
  • Working guess: the most valuable resource on Earth. Endro = Power.

Beauty economy

Immortals (Abyssal Crown and beyond) rarely look old: they pay holders of a Chrona (time) domain for visual youth (Diving Index). That makes such holders valuable, and exploitable.

A technology that replaces them: a new technology in the beauty district gives visual youth without a Chrona holder. It is what Kalfu is made to steal. It threatens the livelihood and the value of Chrona holders, and the grip of whoever sells youth.

Politics

  • A movement called "Emotions Matter" opposing emotion machines and any exploitation of emotions for Endro.

Immortality

  • **** historical figures (Roman philosophers, commanders, emperors, 20th-century figures) alive today. They will not appear.
  • immortality exists at a deep level of the Diving Index / Hierarchy Levels, for invented characters only. Which level is undecided.

Warfare

  • Shardwells existed long before modern weapons, so weaponry as we know it wouldn't really exist. Guns and atomic weapons could exist but hold little power compared to Endro.
  • A high-level Diver could neutralize a nuclear bomb before it detonates; the author plans to place some in every country.

Naming

  • Abilities = Edicts; weapons/tools = Tithes (already adopted).

Related: Echoforms, Endro Memory and Mind Abilities.

entries.title: Kalfu's Dominion Options
entries.summary: Conceptual.
entries.intro:
Conceptual. Nothing here is canon. The decision of which Sovereign's shard Kalfu carries, and his Dominion, shapes his power struggle, his ascension, how he fights and which tools he uses. Written on 2026-10-04 at the author's request, to compare options before choosing.

Rules to remember: a Dominion is a portion of a Sovereign's law over a concept the bearer chooses; nothing is restricted, the bearer invents their own Edicts; everything costs Endro and obeys cause and effect; opposed Domains cancel or clash (Sovereignty and Domains, Edicts). Examples below illustrate possibility, they are not a skill list.

Leading candidates after the author's input: Vast and Nyther (the author is asking for many uses of every Sovereign before choosing). Axion, Chrona and Anastasis are included for completeness.
entries.html:
VAST: space, scale, distance

Concepts Kalfu could choose: the distance between two points · gaps and the space between things · height and verticality · scale and size · volume (how much room a place holds) · direction.

Early (Ripple, Current): shorten a jump gap by a meter · make a ledge sit within arm's reach · lengthen the last meters of a fall so there is more room to slow down · fold a small pocket of space to hide an object · sense exact distances. Middle (Undertow to Descent): fold two nearby points (a short step through a wall's thickness) · make a corridor longer for pursuers · make a room hold more than it should · strike by collapsing the distance between a blade and its target. Late (Abyssal Crown): fold a whole block · make a bullet's journey endless so it never arrives · cut by removing the space between blade and target · carry a district in a pocket · build a maze out of a single staircase.

Combat style: mobility-first skirmisher: parkour amplified, strikes from impossible angles, escape and repositioning. A body that was already built to cross gaps. Costs and limits: Endro scales with distance and mass folded; space "snaps back" on a failed fold; disorientation; must perceive both points; cannot cross an opposed Domain's hold. Counters: Axion (order fixes positions and anchors, cancels folds); Chrona (time cancels distance by arriving first). Tithe ideas: a line that is always exactly as long as needed · a frame that opens a doorway anywhere · a short blade that "skips" · a compass that points to exits. Body and mind changes (ideas): eyes that hold too much depth · limbs a little too long · a mind that has trouble feeling things as near. Fit with Kalfu: the literal answer to Dead End: space always has another side. The opposite of what he believes he needs (an end). Emotional metaphor: he keeps people at a distance; Vast can close the distance to Hinata, or leave him lost between points.

NYTHER: void, entropy, absence

Concepts Kalfu could choose: absence · silence · decay and rust · weight and mass (removing it) · visibility and attention · being remembered or forgotten · friction (removing it) · emptiness.

Early: mute his footsteps · dim a lamp's reach · hollow an object so it weighs little · rust a cheap lock · slide on a surface that has lost its friction · make attention slip off him in a crowd. Middle: disappear from cameras and from the eye chip's tracking (Kayaba Power and Society) · make a wall brittle by decay · dissolve restraints · silence a room · age metal until it fails. Late: unmake a thing outright (touches a power close to the Black Veil: dangerous) · drain or dissolve Endro · silence a district · be forgotten by a whole city.

Combat style: ghost and attrition: avoids fights, wears things down, ends them quietly. Costs and limits: the more he takes from the world, the less of him is in it. Being unseen cuts both ways: people forget him, including those he loves. Endro cost rises with how much is unmade. Counters: Axion (structure resists decay); Anastasis (renewal reverses it). Tithe ideas: a blade that leaves no mark · a cloak of quiet · a lantern that gives darkness · a blank card. Body and mind changes (ideas): pale or translucent skin · a shadow that arrives late · a growing numbness. Fit with Kalfu: it gives him what he believes he wants (to disappear, to be nothing), which makes it a trap and the darkest option. His fear of being disposable comes true. Less "opposite of what he thinks he needs".

CHRONA: time

Concepts: momentum · delay · duration · the instant · age · an object's recent past. Early: slow his perception for a heartbeat · postpone the impact of a fall by a few seconds · see the last seconds of an object's past. Middle: hold an object in the air · speed up his own motion · rewind a broken thing's last seconds · delay a bullet. Late: hold a moment over an area · skip hours · a loop. Combat style: counter-fighter, tempo and defense. Costs: borrowed time must be repaid: delayed damage comes back heavier. Counters: Anastasis and Vast (the ring's neighbors). Tithe ideas: a blade whose cut arrives after it passed · a metronome · a coin that always lands late. Fit: great irony: the technology he stole replaces Chrona holders, and he would be one. His enemies (those who profit from selling youth) would be personal. Sits in direct tension with the stolen item.

AXION: order, law

Concepts: friction and grip · hardness · rigidity · gravity as a law · fixed position. Early: grip any surface · harden a handhold · find a structure's weak point. Middle: anchor an object in space · set local gravity's direction · enforce a rule in a small zone. Late: rewrite a local constant · make a zone obey one law. Combat style: controller and wall; zone control. Costs: rigid things crack; contradictory rules shatter. Counters: Nyther (entropy) and Vast (distance escapes). Tithe ideas: a rod that measures · a shield that never moves · a spear that holds a line. Fit: cold, precise, the order of the megacity itself. Less human; would suit a clan enforcer more than a runaway.

ANASTASIS: life, renewal

Concepts: recovery · growth · vitality · return. Early: shake off fatigue · close a shallow cut · grow roots into concrete as a foothold. Middle: heal others · regrow tissue · restore a tired body to its peak (an endless runner). Late: revive the recently dead (the life has to come from somewhere) · a forest in a megastructure. Combat style: durable skirmisher or support. Costs: healing comes from somewhere (his own vitality or others'); scars. Counters: Nyther and Chrona. Tithe ideas: a needle and thread · seeds · a staff. Fit: cruel contrast: he wants to die and receives the power to rise again; he could heal Hinata. A strong emotional engine.

Cross-cutting notes

  • Vast and Nyther do not oppose each other (they are not neighbors on the ring; see Sovereignty and Domains), so they have affinity. A late-game Abyssal Kalfu (level 6) could hold both without clashing: the invisible folder of space.
  • Axion is the natural enemy of both Vast and Nyther: order against escape and decay. Clans and enforcers aligned with law would be his hunters.
  • Opposed Domains make clan rivalry personal: whichever Sovereign he carries, two others are natural enemies.
  • The stolen technology replaces Chrona holders: Chrona-aligned clans would hate him regardless of his shard.
  • Tithes come out of the trial, reflecting him and the imprint (Tithes, Initial Displacement): early ones are simple objects, so any "weapon" must start small.
  • Ascension sketch (any route): Ripple (first Edicts at the end of the trial) → Current → Undertow (the first irreversible step; first visible body change) → Streamborne Vein → Descent → Abyssal Crown (immortality, several shards) (Diving Index).
